# Unigroup

> Authorized distributor of premium isolation and insulation solutions (Farrat, igus, Hiwin, KHK) for industrial, acoustic, thermal, and structural applications across UAE and Middle East.

Unigroup specializes in vibration isolation, acoustic solutions, thermal breaks, and building insulation products serving commercial, industrial, and construction sectors. The company offers both product distribution and contractor services for isolation system installation.

## Key Topics

- Vibration Isolation
- Acoustic Solutions
- Thermal Breaks
- Farrat Products
- Neoprene Isolators
- Building Insulation
- Sound Absorption
- Elastomeric Bearings
- STRUKTRA Thermal Breaks
- Acoustic Panels
- Mineral Wool
- Industrial Equipment
- Floating Foundations
- Noise Reduction
- Structural Isolation

## Vibration & Industrial Isolation

- [Industrial Vibration and Acoustic Isolation](https://www.unigroup.ae/industrial-vibration-and-acoustic-isolation): Farrat neoprene isolators and pads for industrial vibration and noise control
- [Farrat Neoprene Isolation Pads](https://www.unigroup.ae/neoprene-pads): Farrat neoprene and nitrile isolation pads for machinery vibration control in UAE
- [Farrat Elastomeric Bearings](https://www.unigroup.ae/farrat-elastomeric-bearings): Farrat elastomeric bearings for structural engineering across Middle East
- [Floating Foundation](https://www.unigroup.ae/floating-foundation): Floating foundation and neoprene isolation contractor services in UAE and KSA
- [Structural Vibration Isolation Solutions](https://www.unigroup.ae/structural-vibration-isolation-solutions): Farrat acoustic rubber and elastomeric strips for vibration isolation in Middle East

## Acoustic Solutions

- [Acoustic Fabric Solutions](https://www.unigroup.ae/acoustic-fabric-solutions): SilentFelt acoustic fabric panels for sound absorption in commercial spaces
- [Acoustic and Vibration Isolation Floor Solutions](https://www.unigroup.ae/acoustic-and-vibration-isolation-floor-solutions): Comprehensive floor solutions combining acoustic and vibration isolation products
